summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with the tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed); the wider test/test_extras run gave 118 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing is committed. mypy, black and isort are not installed in the prepared venv, so the type-check and formatting requirements are unverified. The likeliest mypy issue is the unreachable non-Node raise in shacl.py, which may need a type-ignore or a different check.
